## What changed?

Describe the change and link the issue or proposal, if any.

## Why?

Explain the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List commands run and results. For UI changes, attach desktop/mobile screenshots.

- [ ] I described what changed and why.
- [ ] I ran relevant tests and reported any failures honestly.
- [ ] I included screenshots for UI changes (or marked this not applicable).
- [ ] I committed no secrets, credentials, private data, or local environment files.
- [ ] I kept unrelated changes out of this PR.
- [ ] I considered security, abuse, and production isolation.
- [ ] I identified database/schema/Firestore-rule changes and compatibility requirements, or confirmed none.
- [ ] I identified breaking changes and migration needs, or confirmed none.

This PR does not authorize production access or deployment. Only maintainer-reviewed
changes may reach protected main. Never put vulnerability details or credentials here;
use SECURITY.md for private disclosure.
